Olivia (People Ops): Hey team — quick reminder: all-hands in 30m in the main room. Agenda pinned below, pls drop any questions here so we can triage. Recording will be up after; we’ll also attach the takeaway doc. :loudspeaker:

Maya (Product): Agenda looks good. Can we add a 5-min slot for the launch retrospective? Would like to surface the billing edge case we saw.

Sam (Eng): +1 on the retro. Also quick FYI: deploy rollout notes will be 1 slide.

Devin (Infra): Heads up — we have a small policy update around usage quotas for free-tier orgs. Will cover why and the timeline. TL;DR: changes effective in two weeks, with a 7-day grace period.

Alex (Research): Can we include a short demo of the quantized model perf numbers? 3 slides max.

Olivia (People Ops): Yes to demo. Action: if you have slides, drop them to the shared folder by EOD. Link: https://redwood.internal/allhands/apr-briefing

InfraBot: Recording processed and will be posted to #all-hands-recordings after the meeting.

Katie (Comms): Qs we should collect before the meeting: - billing impact details for customers - rollback plan for Dedicated - public messaging cadence. Drop any further Qs here or add to the doc. :memo:

Jen (Support): Noted — I’ll paste top 5 customer questions we’ve seen this week into the doc.

Sam (Eng): Quick note for retro: include the incident timeline snippet. Copy: ```03:42 - cache miss spike, 03:50 - autoscaler kicked, 04:05 - partial rollback```

Maya (Product): Thanks. For the policy change, we’ll surface examples and a mitigation guide for teams running high-burst workloads.

Olivia (People Ops): Perfect. Final reminder: all-hands starts at 10:00 PT. If you can’t attend, we’ll circulate the recording + action items within 24h. See you there. :coffee:
